# `@ashstack/zod`

_auto-enabled when `zod` is a dependency._

- [`prefer-enum`](#ashstackzodprefer-enum)

## `@ashstack/zod/prefer-enum`

Disallow `z.nativeEnum()` and any `z.union()` whose members are all `z.literal()` strings.

**Default: on**, when `zod` is a dependency.

**Fails**

```tsx
import { View } from "react-native";
import { z } from "zod";

enum AlertType {
  LowMoisture = "LOW_MOISTURE",
  MissedDelivery = "MISSED_DELIVERY",
}

export const alertTypeSchema = z.nativeEnum(AlertType);

export const statusSchema = z.union([z.literal("draft"), z.literal("published")]);

export const Panel = () => <View />;
```

**Passes**

```tsx
import { View } from "react-native";
import { z } from "zod";

enum AlertType {
  LowMoisture = "LOW_MOISTURE",
  MissedDelivery = "MISSED_DELIVERY",
}

export const alertTypeSchema = z.enum(AlertType);

export const statusSchema = z.enum(["draft", "published"]);

export const mixedUnion = z.union([z.literal("manual"), z.number()]);

export const Panel = () => <View />;
```
